facts.fact: Terra Industries, a Nigerian defence-technology startup, closed an additional USD 18 million, taking its seed round to USD 52 million; new investors were Norleo Space Investments and angel Grant Gordon, joining existing investors 8VC, Silent Ventures, Nova Global, Belief Capital and SV Angel (TechCabal; the article does not give the investors' home countries).
facts.system: Terra Industries seed round, USD 52 million

facts.fact: Terra Industries, a Nigerian defence-technology startup, raised USD 11.75 million in January 2026, which TechCabal calls the largest funding round in African defence tech; the article names no investor and no home country for them.

Terra Industries, a Nigerian defence-technology startup, raised a USD 22 million follow-on round led by Lux Capital one month after its January 2026 round; the article does not give the investors' home countries.
facts.system: Terra Industries follow-on round led by Lux Capital
